summary: A read of a send found that the message came back as a bounce, with its kind, the moment and the provider's own word for it; said once per send, and once more where a bounce first said soft is found to stop.

key.description: The work item that made the send. A send is said once, under its id, and once more, under its id and `/stop`, where the first line says soft and a later read says hard or names no kind: that line stops the address. After a line that stops, nothing more is said of the send.

plugin.description: The plugin that answered the read.

reference.description: The provider's reference for the send, as the send returned it.

message_id.description: The provider's identifier for the message that went, or null where it gives none.

bounce.description: The kind of bounce: `hard` where the address does not take mail, `soft` for every other kind the provider names, one the plugin does not know included, null only where the provider said the message bounced and named no kind.

bounce_code.description: The provider's own word for the kind, uninterpreted: one word of the provider's vocabulary, never a server's text; null where it gives none.

bounced_at.description: When the bounce notice came, or null where the provider gives no moment.

read_work_item.description: The work item that read the send's status.
